description:
Outcome: Gardeners report their own plot problems and coordinator sees open reports and resolves them, from brief.md item 4.
Scope: Plain text report tied to authenticated household/current allocation, durable created timestamp and confirmation, coordinator open list/detail/resolve. Persist client submission idempotency key per household/request; preserve original plot association.
Excludes: Attachments and chat.
Acceptance: Unauthorized plot reports refused; saved report survives reload; idempotent resolution removes from open list without deleting history. Retry of a timed-out committed submission returns the same report and cannot create a second digest entry; separate deliberate reports allowed.
Behaviour: Accessible validation, retained input on failure, clear empty/open/resolved states and duplicate-safe submission retry.
Verification: Submission/resolution end-to-end, household/role permissions, retry-after-commit and historical association tests.
Prerequisites: T-003, T-005, T-007.
Assumptions: Reports require current allocation; original association preserved even after later correction.
title: Report plot problems and resolve them
